button.infoText: Go to the previous line of dialogue.
Go to the next line of dialogue.

textbutton.infoText: Skip to the end of the current line's letter-by-letter display.
Add a new line of dialogue after the current one.
Remove the current line of dialogue.

checkbox.infoText: If this is checked, the current line will be added to the end of the previous one instead of replacing it.

dropdown.infoText: The character that should say the current line of dialogue.
The face that the character saying the line should make.

togglebutton.infoText: Put the character on the left side of the dialogue box.
Put the character on the right side of the dialogue box.

dropdown.infoText: An optional voice line to play on the current line of dialogue.

textbutton.infoText: Stop playing the currently selected voiceline.

dropdown.infoText: An optional sound to play on the current line of dialogue.

stepper.infoText: The volume at which to play the above sound.

input.infoText: If this is not blank, the current line of dialogue will trigger the "onDialogueEvent" function in scripts with the current dialogue and entered event as arguments.

textbutton.infoText: The color of the solid background behind the dialogue.

stepper.infoText: The transparency of the solid background behind the dialogue.

input.infoText: An optional image to show as the background behind the dialogue.

checkbox.infoText: If this is checked, changing the background image will cause it to affect every following line where the background was the same.

stepper.infoText: The amount of time it takes the background to fade in, in seconds.
The amount of time it takes the dialogue to fade out, in seconds.

dropdown.infoText: The box that should be shown on the current line of dialogue.
The style the dialogue box should use on the current line of dialogue.

stepper.infoText: How fast the dialogue should show. A higher number means the dialogue shows slower.

dropdown.infoText: The music that should be playing on the current line of dialogue, or "none" to stop the music.

checkbox.infoText: If this is checked, changing the music will cause it to affect every following line where the music was the same.

stepper.infoText: The volume the music should play at.
The time it takes to fade the music in or out, in seconds.
